This device controls media volume externally.

ManaPlayer 1.2.0
A music player for standalone Android head units and Android 6.0+ devices. Not Android Auto or Android Automotive OS.

Set up storage, search, and manage queues only while parked. Do not use the screen while driving.

Use Settings to choose English or Chinese, appearance, loop mode, playback order, and any combination of saved music folders. Add folders one at a time with Android's picker. Android may require a Music subfolder instead of a volume root.

MP3, AAC/M4A, FLAC, PCM WAV, Ogg Vorbis, and Ogg Opus are supported when the device decoder supports the file. WMA, DRM, DSD, and arbitrary codecs are not promised. Tags and artwork also depend on the device.

Rescans retain missing references; they never delete music. Reconnect the same USB drive and rescan, or reselect its folder if permission was revoked. Temporary grants may need reselection after restart. USB power, filesystems, and document-provider support depend on the head unit.

Standard Android music widgets and Android/Bluetooth media keys can control playback. Select ManaPlayer in the widget if it has a player selection setting. Proprietary CAN/steering-wheel integration is not included. The last queue restores paused; nothing autoplays at boot or launch.
Choose music folders and manage your library only while parked. Removing a library reference never deletes your music files.
Stop playback and clear the saved queue? Your library and music files stay unchanged.
Search title, artist, album, file, or genre
Your music, your space.\nAdd a folder or open a file in Folders to begin.
No folders yet.\nUse Add folder for internal storage or a USB drive exposed by Android. Setup works best while parked.

Remove “%1$s” from ManaPlayer, along with tracks that belong only to it? Favorites, playlist entries, and queued references to those tracks will also be removed. Music files will NOT be deleted.
Remove “%1$s” from the library, playlists, favorites, and queue? The actual file will NOT be deleted. A future folder scan can add it again.
Use a unique name of 1 to 80 characters.
Remove “%1$s”? Only the playlist is removed; music files stay untouched.

The provider returned a folder loop. Choose a different folder.

Single file repeats the current song. Folder repeats its saved folder, including subfolders. All selected folders repeats the folders you check below. Sequential follows queue order; Random shuffles it.\n\nOpening one file or a playlist keeps that queue until you change loop mode. Changes never start paused playback.
Add as many folders as you need, one at a time in Android\'s picker. Then check any combination in Select music folders. Unchecking a folder keeps its library references and music files.
Add and select at least one music folder in Settings.
No indexed music in the selected folders. Add or select a folder, then rescan.
No saved folder is available for this song. Add its folder or choose another loop mode.
This song is outside the selected folders. Select its folder in Settings or choose another loop mode.
The current song is outside the new selection. Playback is paused; press Play to start the selected music.
